_description: Office economy actions (#791, #811 item 1). Tour mints the 3 standing lease offers via FinanceEngine.generate_lease_offers; each sign_lease_* action accepts the offer for ONE specific option, so the 1-of-3 choice is a real, selectable fork in the existing static-action UI (no bespoke picker panel needed). Sign ids are keyed to data/office/offices.json lease_option ids -- adding a fourth office means adding a fourth entry here.

actions.name: Tour Offices
actions.description: Go and look at what is on the market. Three landlords will quote you terms; the offers stand for a while.

actions.name: Sign: Co-working corner
actions.description: Cheap in, cheap out, low ceiling. Requires a current quote (tour first).

actions.name: Sign: Walk-up office
actions.description: Middle of everything -- more desks, more rent, a year on the term. Requires a current quote.

actions.name: Sign: University annex
actions.description: The cheapest desk in town if you last two years. Big deposit. Requires a current quote.
